title: ADK Finance Assistant
overview: A two-agent finance assistant combining budget analysis with delegated investment research. Google ADK coordinates OpenAI models through LiteLLM, while public search results retain source links and retrieval timestamps.
features: Root finance agent delegates public research to an investment planning agent.
Structured sample-budget analysis supports savings and allocation conversations.
Search responses preserve public source URLs and UTC retrieval timestamps.
Atomic SQLite admission limits requests and model calls across local processes.
ADK web and command-line entry points support interactive sessions.
role: I integrated OpenAI-backed ADK agents, public search tools, local admission controls, and configuration diagnostics.
challenges: Separating budget inputs from sourced research and retaining timestamps and links for time-sensitive financial information.
impact: I integrated two ADK agents to OpenAI, timestamped public-source research, and shared SQLite request admission.

title: Google Maps MCP & OpenAI Agent
overview: A Google ADK project comparing direct Google Maps function tools with a hosted Maps MCP integration. OpenAI handles the conversation, while the direct tool path supports route summaries and a places search near one route midpoint.
features: Separate agents support direct REST function tools and hosted MCP tool discovery.
Directions tool returns distance, duration, and a Google Maps route link.
Places tool searches within 5 km of a driving-route midpoint and returns up to five results.
CLI and ADK web interfaces share configuration and error handling.
Bounded API requests and structured tool responses connect location data to agent reasoning.
role: I integrated OpenAI reasoning to direct Maps tools and an MCP agent, with configuration checks and bounded API requests.
challenges: Coordinating model-selected tools with Maps API permissions, route summaries, and geographically bounded places search.
impact: I implemented two ADK integration paths for location tools: direct Maps REST functions and hosted MCP tool discovery.

title: ADK Shopping Assistant
overview: A conversational shopping application connecting product discovery, validated carts, and order summaries. Four Google ADK agents coordinate the conversation while Python controls catalogue prices and totals; Redis restores each browser's shopping session.
features: Four specialist agents guide profile collection, catalogue browsing, checkout, and order summaries.
Python validates products and quantities and calculates cart totals from the catalogue.
Streamed responses show progress while the assistant completes each turn.
Redis-backed browser sessions restore the conversation and cart after reload.
Structured checkout summaries retain the selected products, quantities, and calculated totals.
role: I integrated four ADK agents with deterministic catalogue and cart tools, a streamed browser interface, Redis session recovery, and guarded API requests.
challenges: Maintaining consistent state between agent handoffs while ensuring the model cannot invent products, prices, or completed purchases.
impact: Connects product discovery, cart calculation, and order-summary preparation in one conversation. Deterministic Python tools keep products, quantities, and totals consistent across agent handoffs, while Redis preserves the cart after reload.

title: Healthcare Explorer — MCP & OpenAI
overview: A healthcare-data explorer connecting patient search, linked records, risk summaries, and database structure. FastAPI exposes read-only SQLite data through four MCP tools, with an OpenAI assistant that discovers and calls those tools.
features: Search and inspect 10 generated patient profiles with linked records.
Explore rule-based risk summaries and historical readmission indicators.
Inspect five related SQLite tables in the schema view.
Four MCP tools expose schema discovery, bounded SQL queries, risk summaries, and readmission insights.
Authenticated AI requests discover and call the read-only MCP tools.
role: Integrated MCP tools and the bounded OpenAI tool-calling client with a responsive browser explorer, generated SQLite dataset, read-only SQL controls, and Vercel deployment.
challenges: Connecting natural-language questions to structured data while bounding generated SQL, model tool loops, and database access.
impact: Makes linked profile records and five related tables accessible through browser search and four structured tools. Read-only SQL controls support schema exploration and source-grounded answers over the generated dataset.

title: Symposium RAG · Semantic Cache
overview: A document-grounded symposium assistant with persistent exact and semantic answer caching. Event-guide questions return page references, while repeated or semantically similar questions can reuse an answer with its original sources.
features: Browser chat answers questions about a symposium PDF with page references.
OpenAI embeddings and FAISS retrieve guide passages for grounded answers.
Exact and semantic cache lookups retain the original source references.
Upstash Redis shares cached answers across serverless requests.
Request admission, source-index isolation, and controlled errors protect the retrieval workflow.
role: I integrated PDF retrieval, source-page references, persistent semantic caching, shared request admission, and the deployed browser interface.
challenges: Choosing similarity thresholds and isolating cached answers by source index while keeping the app usable without a Valkey service.
impact: Reuses source-grounded answers across repeated questions, avoiding another generation call on a cache hit while retaining the original page references. Persistent Redis storage shares the cache across serverless requests.

title: Symposium PDF RAG Bot
overview: A focused PDF question-answering assistant for a symposium guide. A responsive browser chat connects to a FastAPI retrieval service, combining OpenAI answers with inspectable page references for schedules, event rules, and registration.
features: Separate PDF ingestion builds a FAISS index of overlapping source passages.
Retrieval supplies relevant guide excerpts to the answer prompt.
Answers show deduplicated source-page references in expandable chat details.
Index metadata checks help detect a source or embedding mismatch.
Shared Upstash admission limits requests before provider work.
role: I integrated PDF ingestion, retrieval, answer generation, page-reference display, public API admission, and Vercel delivery.
challenges: Keeping the vector index aligned with its source document and prompting the model to acknowledge information absent from the supplied excerpts.
impact: Turns a five-page guide into a searchable conversation backed by nine indexed passages. Answers connect event schedules, venue details, and registration information to their source pages.

title: Banking Agent Harness
overview: A banking agent harness that keeps model-selected actions inside deterministic Python policies. Transfer requests are staged for confirmation in a later turn, and Redis-backed sessions preserve isolated ledger state and execution outcomes.
features: Five banking tools manage account lookup, beneficiary validation, transfer requests, and ledger results.
Python validates beneficiaries, amounts, balances, and daily limits.
A staged transfer requires explicit confirmation in a later turn.
Tool outcomes and account balances expose whether a ledger operation executed.
Redis-backed browser sessions retain isolated ledger state across requests.
role: Integrated the ADK agent with deterministic transfer policies, confirmation state, isolated ledger execution, request admission, and redacted audit controls.
challenges: Preventing model instructions from bypassing confirmation and ensuring changed transfer details invalidate stale pending state.
impact: Keeps approval in application code: ledger state changes only after a separate confirmation, and changed transfer details invalidate stale approvals. Redis isolates each session's balances and execution history.

title: Agentic AWS Resource Management
overview: An AWS operations assistant adapted from sanjayssnit's agentic resource-management repository. A Streamlit chat interface connects FastAPI and Claude tool calls to AWS Cloud Control operations and CloudWatch log queries.
features: Claude selects structured AWS tools through the Anthropic SDK.
Implemented Cloud Control handlers support resource creation requests, reading, and listing.
Create responses expose an asynchronous request token rather than confirmed resource completion.
CloudWatch tooling retrieves a bounded set of Lambda error log events.
FastAPI connects the tool loop to a Streamlit conversation interface.
role: Adapted and organized the existing AWS agent codebase, retained upstream history, and documented configuration, Cloud Control handlers, and bounded CloudWatch queries.
challenges: Coordinating structured tool calls with implemented Cloud Control create, read, and list operations, including asynchronous creation-request tokens.
impact: Connects conversational requests to structured Cloud Control create, read, and list handlers and bounded Lambda error-log queries through a shared FastAPI tool loop.

title: Multi-Agent Customer Support
overview: A multi-agent customer-support application that gathers order details, validates tickets, and routes requests to billing or refund specialists. A separate human-review queue resolves eligible refund requests and returns the decision to the customer conversation.
features: Multi-turn intake compacts conversation details into a validated Pydantic ticket.
LangGraph routes billing, refund, and general-support workflows.
Read-only SQLite tools retrieve invoices, payments, and refund eligibility from seeded order records.
A separate approver view resolves refund-review requests and updates the customer chat.
Session resume reconnects the customer conversation to its review outcome.
Upstash Redis enforces admission around requests and model calls.
role: I integrated conversational intake, structured ticket validation, deterministic specialist tools, a separate approval graph, session resume, Redis admission, and Streamlit Cloud delivery.
challenges: Keeping customer intake responsive while an independent review graph resolves a request and delivers the outcome to the correct conversation.
impact: Brings structured intake, specialist routing, invoice lookup, and human review into one workflow. Customers can resume their conversation to see the review decision without restarting intake.

title: AI Voice Adventure Assistant
overview: A browser-based voice storytelling assistant that turns a spoken idea into a written and spoken adventure. FastAPI coordinates speech transcription, contextual OpenAI generation, and speech synthesis in one asynchronous workflow.
features: Browser recording, audio upload, and a built-in recording provide multiple input paths.
Transcription, contextual reply generation, and speech synthesis run as a staged async workflow.
Bounded in-memory conversation history supports follow-up turns and session reset.
Recording duration, file formats, and upload sizes are validated.
Manual playback supports browsers that restrict audio autoplay.
role: I integrated browser audio capture to an asynchronous transcription, generation, and speech playback flow with recoverable errors.
challenges: Coordinating three provider stages, committing conversation state only after success, and handling browser recording and autoplay behavior.
impact: Connects audio input, transcription, contextual story generation, and playable MP3 output in one interface. Follow-up turns reuse conversation context, with recoverable processing and playback states.

title: Hybrid RAG Documentation Assistant
overview: Docwise is a documentation assistant that combines keyword and semantic search to answer technical questions with traceable sources. The hosted Python application fuses BM25 and MiniLM ONNX vector results through reciprocal rank fusion before generating a cited answer.
features: Two Markdown documents provide 39 heading-aware indexed passages.
BM25 keyword search and MiniLM ONNX embeddings combine through reciprocal rank fusion.
Answers include validated source labels and expandable retrieved passages.
Questions outside the indexed documentation receive an explicit not-found response.
FastAPI input validation and shared Redis admission control provider requests.
role: I integrated structure-aware ingestion, hybrid retrieval, citation validation, the Docwise browser interface, and a lightweight ONNX deployment for Vercel.
challenges: Preserving code context during chunking and combining keyword precision with semantic recall while keeping source labels tied to retrieved chunks.
impact: Makes 39 passages across two documents searchable through combined keyword and semantic retrieval. Validated citations and inspectable source passages connect answers to the underlying documentation.
